knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

```{r}
wd <- getwd()
data_path <- paste0(dirname(wd), '/data/BRCA_methylation_data.csv')
BRCA_methylation_data_original <- read.csv(data_path, row.names=1)

```

```{r}
wd <- getwd()
data_path <- paste0(dirname(wd), '/data/BRCA_sample_sheet.csv')
BRCA_sample_sheet <- read.csv(data_path, row.names=1)
```

```{r}
head(BRCA_sample_sheet)
```

```{r}
pca_daten <- prcomp(t(BRCA_methylation_data_original))
```

```{r}
pca_daten$sdev
variance_pca_BRCA_methylation_data = (pca_daten$sdev)^2
prop.variance_pca_BRCA_methylation_data = variance_pca_BRCA_methylation_data/sum(variance_pca_BRCA_methylation_data)
names(prop.variance_pca_BRCA_methylation_data) = 1:length(prop.variance_pca_BRCA_methylation_data)


proportion_of_variance <- barplot(prop.variance_pca_BRCA_methylation_data[1:50], 
        ylim = c(0, 0.3), # Anpassung der Y-Achse 
        ylab = 'Proportion of variance', 
        xlab = 'Principal components')

```


```{r}
BRCA_sample_sheet$Type <- as.factor(BRCA_sample_sheet$Type) #Klassifizierungen als Faktor ausgeben, damit diese später angefärbt werden können
color = c('red','blue') #Farben auswählen
cb = color[BRCA_sample_sheet$Type] #Farben den Klassifizierungen zuordnen
pdf("PCA_patients.pdf")
PCA_patients <- plot(pca_daten$x[,1], pca_daten$x[,2], xlab='PC1',ylab='PC2', col=cb, pch = 19)
unique_types <- unique(BRCA_sample_sheet$Type)
legend("bottomleft", legend = unique_types, pch = 19, col=color)
dev.off()
```

### Scree mit dem Base-R-Packet

```{r}
screeplot(pca_daten,
          type='lines',
          main='Scree Plot')
```

```{r}
eigenvalues <- pca_daten$sdev^2
kaizer_criterium <-sum(eigenvalues>1)
kaizer_criterium
```

```{r}
cumulative_variance <- cumsum(eigenvalues) / sum(eigenvalues)

# Anzahl der Komponenten, die mindestens 90% der Varianz erklären
num_components_90 <- sum(cumulative_variance >= 0.90)
num_components_90
```

### Screeplot mit dem factoextra-Packet

```{r}
#install.packages('factoextra')
library(factoextra)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
pdf("Screeplot_PCA_patients.pdf")
Screeplot_PCA_patients <- fviz_eig(pca_daten,
         addlabels=TRUE,
         ylim=c(0,50))
dev.off()
print(Screeplot_PCA_patients)
```
